answers.core: This proposal is not specific to any subset of Godot projects. I believe developers working in any genre, on any scale, will see the value of this feature in project management.
answers.workaround: The need for a deeper project sorting interface seems not only common, but unavoidable for any user who plans to stay with Godot for a long time, as more and more projects are created and developers move on to newer engine releases, some of which will not be backwards-compatible.

title: Custom folders / categories in project list
